verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe returned HTTP 200 for a Railway llms.txt at docs.railway.com. Railway also publishes agent-oriented docs as markdown pages (agents.md, ai/mcp-server.md) and a `use-railway` skill that teaches coding agents how to operate Railway. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming the llms.txt or markdown docs, and evidence on how complete the llms.txt index is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Install the Railway CLI and configure agent support — skills, MCP, and authentication — in one command.
The use-railway skill teaches AI coding agents how to operate Railway.
